svg.title: Schema Mapping Studio — three-step workflow
svg.desc: Workflow showing three steps: Onboard a source via POST /sources, Approve the mapping via PUT approve, then Transform events via POST /transform repeatedly.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens during source onboarding in Schema Mapping Studio?')
sendPrompt('How does the mapping approval step work?')
sendPrompt('How does the transform step work in Schema Mapping Studio?')

svg.text: steps 1 and 2 run once per source · step 3 runs for every event · X-API-Key required
